description: This file defines Express route handler functions for managing evaluators, including CRUD operations, utilizing services and error handling.

methods.name: getAllEvaluators
methods.description: Handles fetching all evaluators with pagination, based on workspace ID from user context.

methods.name: getEvaluator
methods.description: Fetches a specific evaluator by ID within the user's active workspace.

methods.name: createEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a new evaluator with data from request body, associating it with the user's active workspace.

methods.name: updateEvaluator
methods.description: Updates an existing evaluator identified by ID with provided data, within the user's workspace.

methods.name: deleteEvaluator
methods.description: Deletes an evaluator by ID within the user's active workspace.
